scope: Ten completed OpenReasoning Nemotron 1.5B Q4_K_M GCP scalar judge-prompt requests. This fixed-budget local rubric is not official judging, ARC-Easy accuracy or the composite ADTC score.
policy: All ten exact prompts, full answer fields including inline reasoning, and all separate reasoning_content fields were read in two untruncated five-record batches.
Only substantive delivered final text outside think blocks earns criterion points. These ten answer fields never close their inline thinking block.
Every original rubric criterion label and weight is retained. No-final responses receive zero on every criterion, including error-avoidance criteria.
A substantive partial final could receive completed-criterion credit, but none occurs in this set.
The 1,024-token output allowance includes reasoning and is a local campaign setting, not an asserted official competition judge limit.
A zero delivery score does not mean all intermediate calculations are wrong or that unconstrained capability was measured.
The proportional-model prompt appears twice; ten retained positions contain nine unique wordings.
GCP scalar assessments remain separate from Mac Metal results.

source_snapshot.scope: Exact captured prefix of a growing append-only JSONL file; individual record hashes exclude newline.

independent_review.scope: Independent judgment without reading the primary ledger: all ten exact prompts, all ten complete raw answer fields in three untruncated outputs, and all separate reasoning fields were read.
findings: Every answer starts with one literal think tag, has no closing think tag and contains no text outside the reasoning block; every separate reasoning field is empty.
All ten responses terminate by length at 1,024 completion tokens: zero finished finals, zero partial finals, ten reasoning-only outputs and ten truncated responses.
All criteria receive zero under the unchanged delivered-final policy. Correct drafts and final-answer wording inside an unclosed reasoning block are not delivered final text.

models.source_sha256_scope: First 585190 bytes / 125 records captured for this review; source may grow.
observations: All ten requests completed at the 1,024-token allowance; none delivered a final or substantive partial final.
Every nonempty answer field contains an unclosed literal think block. All separately returned reasoning fields are empty.
Correct intermediate work exists, including the ODE solution, chalk calculation and average-speed calculation. It is not credited under the unchanged delivered-final-only rubric.
The zero is a local fixed-budget delivery result, not a claim of zero mathematical knowledge or an official competition disqualification.
No Mac assessment or performance result is substituted for this GCP scalar evidence.

prompts.title: Two Sigma proportional model

criteria.criterion: states direct proportionality R = kP
as personalization tends to zero the rate tends to zero
as personalization tends to infinity the linear rate is unbounded
defines the variables and positive proportionality constant
does not invent a square-root-of-two constant or Kahneman attribution

prompts.reason: The proportional equation and limit statements occur only inside an unclosed inline reasoning block. No final model is delivered; every final-answer criterion receives zero.
